build_module_with_parameters: build a neural network module with parameters, buffers, and submodules using nn.Module
create_hook_forward_pre: create a forward pre-hook on a module to intercept inputs before forward execution
create_hook_backward: create a backward hook on a module to intercept gradients during backpropagation
test_load_state_dict: test loading a state dictionary into a module with strict and assign options
refactor_module_to_device: refactor a module to move all parameters and buffers to a specified device
